headline.text: Disaggregation (perfect-prognosis): given only the block value, the model reproduces panchayat rainfall with 18.8% lower RMSE than copying the block value (95% CI 10.0 to 22.8%) on never-seen panchayats. Forecast mode (ECMWF lead 1-5 input): Rainfall: 7.7% RMSE reduction vs naive block copy (95% CI -0.6 to 17.0%) and 6.2% vs a bias-corrected block forecast, on panchayats never seen in training over 2026-01-01 to 2026-08-31 (lead days 1-5).
